provenance.derived_from: cell.yaml (the human-readable score) — same tree, machine form
provenance.why_this_file_exists: cell-begin runs on the host with python3 stdlib only; there is no YAML parser there. The score stays cell.yaml for reading; this is the exact LayoutNode root that layout.apply receives. If the two ever disagree, cell.yaml is the score and this file is the bug.
provenance.layout_node_contract: request/$defs/LayoutNode, protocol 20, herdr 0.8.2. split requires {type,direction,ratio,first,second}; ratio = share of the FIRST child (verified 0.30 -> 28/94 = 0.298).
provenance.law: podium = non-shell viewer at left 30% (sealed center); desks G,Q,P,V clockwise from top-left; no agents; never 3+1, never 6+1.
